name: dev-suite
description: A suite of portable Windows developer tools that share a design language, a data model and a discovery registry — Dev Hub and Log Viewer, with Markdown Notebook to follow.
author: Stephen Rector

scripts.test:renderer: npm run test:renderer:hub && npm run test:renderer:logs && npm run test:renderer:notes
scripts.test:renderer:notes: node apps/markdown-notebook/tests/renderer/markdown.spec.mjs && node apps/markdown-notebook/tests/renderer/smoke.spec.mjs darwin && node apps/markdown-notebook/tests/renderer/smoke.spec.mjs win32 && node apps/markdown-notebook/tests/renderer/launcher.spec.mjs && node apps/markdown-notebook/tests/renderer/onenote.spec.mjs
scripts.//icons:notes: Markdown Notebook's mark is rasterised from SVG through Playwright's Chromium rather than drawn analytically, so it stays with the app and out of the shared generator — `npm run icons` must not need a 150MB browser download.
